items.text: The system shall provide a dedicated careers area from which users can access job openings and related applicant resources.
items.annotation_notes: The sequence starts on an MBTA Careers landing page and then moves into a dedicated Job Openings area, showing that the careers portal supports entry into the hiring workflow.
items.manual_verification_notes: the evidence could include every step

claims.claim: A dedicated careers area provides access to job openings and related applicant resources.

items.evidence_note: Steps 1 and 2 show MBTA Careers, View MBTA job openings, helpful resources, and job posting alerts.
items.rationale: The visible careers area supports both job-opening access and applicant resources.

items.text: The system shall allow users to browse a catalog of open job postings in a dedicated job listings view.
items.annotation_notes: The catalog view is directly visible.

claims.claim: A dedicated job listings view provides a browsable catalog of open job postings.

items.evidence_note: The Job Openings page lists multiple jobs and reports jobs found.
items.rationale: The catalog view is directly visible.

items.text: The system shall support discoverability of job postings through keyword search over the listings catalog.
items.annotation_notes: A search field is persistently visible on the job openings page while the user browses filtered and unfiltered results.

claims.claim: The listings catalog includes a keyword search field.

items.evidence_note: A Search input is visible above the job listings.
items.rationale: The requirement asks for a search mechanism, and the mechanism is visible.

items.text: The system shall allow applicants to filter job openings by department.
items.annotation_notes: The filter drawer exposes a Department facet and a department selection count becomes active after selection, showing department-based refinement.

claims.claim: The filter panel provides a Department facet with selectable department options.
Selecting a department filter narrows the results to postings for that department.

items.evidence_note: The Department filter is visible, MBTA - Safety appears, and the result set changes to safety jobs.
items.rationale: Department filtering is visibly available and applied.

items.text: The system shall allow applicants to filter job openings by estimated annual salary range or threshold.
items.annotation_notes: The filter flow includes an Estimated Annual Salary facet with selectable salary bands including a $100,000+ option.

claims.claim: The filter panel provides an Estimated Annual Salary facet with selectable salary thresholds.
Selecting an estimated salary range or threshold narrows the job results.

items.evidence_note: The salary drawer lists $100,000+, and after selection the page shows 3 jobs found.
items.rationale: Salary threshold filtering is visibly available and applied.

items.text: The system shall support combining multiple filter criteria to narrow job results.
items.annotation_notes: Multiple active filters are visibly combined.

claims.claim: Multiple filter criteria can be active at the same time and narrow the job results.

items.evidence_note: The filter drawer shows active counts for Department and Estimated Annual Salary, and the main page shows 3 jobs found.
items.rationale: Multiple active filters are visibly combined.

items.text: The system shall provide visible feedback about how many filters are active and which filter categories currently contain selections.
items.annotation_notes: Badges and counters are shown on the filter panel and on the main Filter control, making active refinement state visible to the user.

claims.claim: The system provides both a total active-filter count and category-level active-filter indicators.

items.evidence_note: The main Filter control shows 2, and the filter panel shows badges on Department and Estimated Annual Salary.
items.rationale: The active filter state is visibly communicated.

items.text: The system shall keep the displayed result set consistent with the selected filter criteria and the reported jobs found count.
items.annotation_notes: After the department and salary selections are active, the listings show three matching safety jobs with salaries above 100k, but full data correctness still depends on backend filtering logic.
items.manual_verification_notes: The UI implementation doesn't depend on requirement

claims.claim: The system keeps the displayed result set consistent with the selected filter criteria and the reported jobs found count.

items.evidence_note: The UI shows 3 jobs found and three visible MBTA - Safety postings after Department and $100,000+ filters are active.
items.rationale: Visible consistency is supported, but full data/filter correctness cannot be proven from screenshots alone.

items.text: The system shall expose posting recency and closing-status information in the job results so users can judge which openings are most recent or still open.
items.annotation_notes: List entries display posting age and closing indicators such as 'Posted 2 weeks ago' and 'Closes in 14 hours', which support latest-opening review.

claims.claim: Job result entries expose posting recency and closing-status information.

items.evidence_note: Listings show values such as Posted 2 weeks ago, Posted more than 30 days ago, Closes in 14 hours, and Closes in 1 day.
items.rationale: The relevant status information is visible in the result cards.

items.text: The system shall present summary information for each job in list view, including title, compensation, department, and a brief description.
items.annotation_notes: Each listing card includes the job title, salary, department, and summary text before the user opens a detail view.

claims.claim: Visible job cards include title, compensation, department, and brief description text.

items.evidence_note: The visible listings show job titles, salary ranges, Department labels, and summary descriptions.
items.rationale: The required summary fields are present in list view.

items.text: The system shall allow users to navigate from a job listing to a detailed view for an individual opening.
items.annotation_notes: The flow moves from a filtered job list to a detailed panel for a selected opening, showing list-to-detail navigation.

claims.claim: A selected listing opens an individual job detail view.

items.evidence_note: Step 13 shows the selected Safety Lead Investigator listing, and step 14 shows its detail flyout.
items.rationale: List-to-detail navigation is visibly demonstrated.

items.text: The system shall preserve the applicant's current discovery context while moving between pages, filtering and job detail viewing.
items.annotation_notes: The filtered context leads into a selected job detail from the same narrowed result set, but persistence behavior across all navigation cases is only partially observable.

claims.claim: The system preserves the applicant's current discovery context while moving between pages, filtering and job detail viewing.
claims.note: It is strongly indicated by a consistent walkthrough through the flow.

items.evidence_note: The detail flyout opens over the filtered three-job result context.
items.rationale: The observed transition preserves context, but the broader persistence claim is not fully covered.

items.text: The system shall support sharing job postings through external channels such as social media and email.
items.annotation_notes: Social and email style action icons are visible beside job entries and in the detail panel, suggesting posting-sharing functionality, though the behavior is not executed here.

claims.claim: Job listings show social and email-style sharing controls.
Actual handoff or delivery through an external channel occurs.

items.evidence_note: Sharing icons are visible on listing cards, but no external share flow is executed.
items.rationale: Visible sharing affordances are supported, while the external behavior remains unverified.

items.text: The system shall allow users to subscribe to job posting alerts for future openings.
items.annotation_notes: The careers landing page includes a dedicated Job Posting Alerts area, which strongly indicates an alert subscription capability even though the enrollment flow is not shown.

claims.claim: The system has a enter for the Future Job Postings area.
The system walks the user through the sign up process for future job posting alerts.

items.evidence_note: The careers page shows Job Posting Alerts and Sign up for job posting alerts.
items.rationale: The subscription entry mechanism is visible, but subscription completion is not verified.

items.text: The system shall allow users to sort job listings by multiple criteria, including posting date, title, and salary.
items.annotation_notes: The requested sort criteria are visibly available.

claims.claim: The system exposes multiple sorting criteria, including posting date, title, and salary.

items.evidence_note: The sort panel lists Posting Date, Job Title, and Salary options.
items.rationale: The requested sort criteria are visibly available.

items.text: The system shall present comprehensive job details before application, including salary, location, job type, job number, closing information, department, and full descriptive content.
items.annotation_notes: The required detail information is visible before application.

claims.claim: The detailed job view shows salary, location, job type, job number, closing information, department, and descriptive content before application.

items.evidence_note: The detail flyout shows the requested metadata, Description content, and an Apply button.
items.rationale: The required detail information is visible before application.

items.text: The system shall provide an explicit action for applicants to begin applying from the detailed job view.
items.annotation_notes: The explicit application entry action is visible.

claims.claim: The detailed job view includes a visible Apply action.

items.evidence_note: The Safety Lead Investigator detail flyout has an Apply button.
items.rationale: The explicit application entry action is visible.

items.text: The system shall support a downstream application workflow after the applicant selects Apply for a job.
items.annotation_notes: The entry point is supported, but the downstream workflow is missing from the flow.

claims.claim: The system supports a downstream application workflow after the applicant selects Apply for a job.

items.evidence_note: Step 14 shows Apply, but no later application form or workflow is visible.
items.rationale: The entry point is supported, but the downstream workflow is missing from the flow.

items.text: The system shall allow users to create a job alert directly from their current search and filter context so future matching openings can be delivered without re-entering the criteria.
items.annotation_notes: The general alert capability is supported, while current-context persistence is missing or hidden.

claims.claim: A general job-alert sign-up mechanism is visible.
No job-alert creation control tied directly to the current filtered search context is shown.
Future delivery of matching openings without re-entering criteria depends on hidden persistence and notification behavior.

items.evidence_note: General alert signup is visible, but save-current-search or alert-from-current-filter behavior is not visible.
items.rationale: The general alert capability is supported, while current-context persistence is missing or hidden.

items.text: The system shall provide visible confirmation that a selected job posting has been handed off to the chosen external sharing channel or compose surface.
items.annotation_notes: Only the entry mechanism is supported; the required confirmation is missing.

claims.claim: Sharing-style controls are visible for job postings.
No selected external sharing channel, compose surface, or visible handoff confirmation is shown.

items.evidence_note: Sharing affordances are visible, but no sharing action or confirmation appears.
items.rationale: Only the entry mechanism is supported; the required confirmation is missing.

items.text: The system shall ensure that every job shown after search and filtering satisfies all selected criteria across the complete result set, not only the initially visible listings.
items.annotation_notes: Visible local consistency is supported, but the universal correctness claim cannot be fully proven.

claims.claim: After filtering, the system reports a jobs-found count and presents the corresponding postings.
Ensuring every job in the complete result set satisfies the selected criteria depends on data correctness and filtering behavior.

items.evidence_note: The UI shows Showing 1-3 of 3 jobs after filtering, but full correctness remains hidden.
items.rationale: Visible local consistency is supported, but the universal correctness claim cannot be fully proven.

items.text: The system shall allow public browsing of job listings and posting details, while requiring applicant authentication before entering the application workflow.
items.annotation_notes: Public browsing is supported; the authentication policy before application is not verified.

claims.claim: Public browsing of listings and posting details is visible without an authenticated session.
Requiring applicant authentication before entering the application workflow is not established by the captured flow.

items.evidence_note: Listings and details are browsable while Sign In is visible, but the post-Apply authentication boundary is not shown.
items.rationale: Public browsing is supported; the authentication policy before application is not verified.

items.text: The system shall provide a visible control on the detailed job view that starts the application workflow for the selected opening.
items.annotation_notes: The requirement centers on the visible control, and that control is present.

claims.claim: The detailed job view provides a visible Apply control for the selected opening.
Starting the application after pressing Apply is a routine dependency behind the visible control.

items.evidence_note: The selected Safety Lead Investigator detail flyout includes an Apply button.
items.rationale: The requirement centers on the visible control, and that control is present.
